title: October 2026 LangChain Newsletter: Everything we shipped at Interrupt NYC & London
html:
Any company can use AI. The ones that see lasting value will own their intelligence: the model, the harness, and the context that turn a generic model into one that knows your business.

At Interrupt NYC and London, we shipped new features to enable teams to own their intelligence, giving them more control over how they build, understand, and improve their agents in production.

New in LangSmith

🔎 LangSmith AI Search: Find conversations based on a semantic understanding of your traces, with questions like “did the user get frustrated?” or “did PII leak?” without relying on traditional filters.

🤖 Managed Deep Agents v0.9: Build dynamic, personalized agents that are tailored to each run's context, react in Slack, have user-level memory and tool use, schedule tasks, and more. Plus, built-in web search for free.

🛡️ LangSmith Engine v2: Catch issues before they reach production with Red Teaming. Engine v2 also detects harder-to-spot issues like inefficient agent work and metric trends, and automatically tests and validates its proposed fixes.

🧭 LangSmith Trajectories: Navigate trace data and follow your agent’s path with a chronological view of each session across the main agent and its subagents.

🧩 LangSmith Custom Apps: Build, publish, and run custom interfaces directly in LangSmith, turning recurring workflows into shared tools built on your LangSmith data.

🎛️ LangSmith Fine-Tuning: Turn production trajectories into training data, fine-tune models with Baseten or Fireworks, then evaluate and serve the tuned models.

Open source

🔧 LangChain v1.4.0: LangChain now supports FastMCP through the 

langchain.mcp
namespace.

⚡ Building production agents with Jev and LangGraph: See how LangGraph orchestrates Jev, TypeSafe AI’s decision model, to build agents that are faster and cheaper to run.

The Agentic Operating Model: How teams are running production AI at scale

The Agentic Operating Model looks at how leading teams bring people, processes, and technology together to scale production AI. It covers rethinking the agent development lifecycle, building continuous evaluation practices, and embedding governance: what it takes to move beyond experimentation and run agents reliably at scale. Join an upcoming virtual session to explore the framework and what it looks like in practice.

title_zh: 2026 年 10 月 LangChain 时事通讯：我们在 Interrupt NYC 和 London 运送的所有物品
html_zh:
任何公司都可以使用人工智能。那些看到持久价值的人将拥有自己的智慧：将通用模型转变为了解您业务的模型、工具和环境。

在 Interrupt NYC 和伦敦，我们推出了新功能，使团队能够拥有自己的情报，让他们更好地控制如何在生产中构建、理解和改进代理。

LangSmith新产品

🔎 LangSmith AI 搜索：根据对痕迹的语义理解来查找对话，并提出“用户是否感到沮丧？”等问题。或“PII 是否泄露？”无需依赖传统过滤器。

🤖 托管深度代理 v0.9 ：构建动态、个性化的代理，这些代理针对每次运行的上下文量身定制，在 Slack 中做出反应，具有用户级内存和工具使用、计划任务等。另外，免费内置网络搜索。

🛡️ LangSmith Engine v2 ：通过 Red Teaming 在问题进入生产之前发现问题。 Engine v2 还可以检测难以发现的问题，例如低效的代理工作和指标趋势，并自动测试和验证其建议的修复方案。

🧭 LangSmith 轨迹：导航跟踪数据并通过主代理及其子代理的每个会话的时间顺序视图来跟踪代理的路径。

🧩 LangSmith 自定义应用程序：直接在 LangSmith 中构建、发布和运行自定义界面，将重复出现的工作流程转变为基于 LangSmith 数据构建的共享工具。

🎛️ LangSmith Fine-Tuning ：将生产轨迹转化为训练数据，使用 Baseten 或 Fireworks 微调模型，然后评估并服务调整后的模型。

开源

🔧 LangChain v1.4.0 : LangChain 现在通过以下方式支持 FastMCP

langchain.mcp
命名空间。

⚡使用 Jev 和 LangGraph 构建生产代理：了解 LangGraph 如何协调 Jev（TypeSafe AI 的决策模型）来构建运行速度更快、成本更低的代理。

代理运营模型：团队如何大规模运行生产人工智能

代理运营模型着眼于领先团队如何将人员、流程和技术结合在一起以规模化生产人工智能。它涵盖了重新思考代理开发生命周期、构建持续评估实践和嵌入治理：如何超越实验并大规模可靠地运行代理。加入即将举行的虚拟会议，探索该框架及其在实践中的样子。
